summary: Itau Unibanco Holding S.A. filed a Form 6-K on April 29, 2026, furnishing the summarized minutes of its Annual General Stockholders Meeting held on April 28, 2026. The meeting, conducted remotely, covered routine agenda items: approval of management accounts and financial statements for fiscal year 2025, allocation of profits (including dividends and interest on capital), election of board members (not detailed in excerpt), and determination of management compensation. Quorum was 92.27% of common shares and 45.25% of preferred shares. No special situations such as acquisitions, divestitures, restructuring, or management changes were disclosed. This is a routine annual meeting filing—no special-situation category applies.
